inventory.sourceFigureDescription: ONE THREE-COLUMN TEXT TABLE (PURE TEXT — ZERO rasters on pdf 265; pdfimages returns no rows; COPYRIGHTED, never reproduced as artwork). Header: 'α-blockers'. Column headers: DRUG / APPLICATIONS / ADVERSE EFFECTS. Four rows grouped by selectivity: 'Nonselective' + 'Phenoxybenzamine' → 'Irreversible. Pheochromocytoma (used preoperatively) to prevent catecholamine (hypertensive) crisis.'; 'Phentolamine' → 'Reversible. Given to patients on MAO inhibitors who eat tyramine-containing foods and for severe cocaine-induced hypertension (2nd line). Also used to treat norepinephrine extravasation.' (shared adverse cell: 'Orthostatic hypotension, reflex tachycardia.'); 'α1 selective (-osin ending)' + 'Prazosin, terazosin, doxazosin, tamsulosin' → 'Urinary symptoms of BPH; PTSD (prazosin); hypertension (except tamsulosin).' | '1st-dose orthostatic hypotension, dizziness, headache.'; 'α2 selective' + 'Mirtazapine' → 'Depression.' | 'Sedation, ↑ serum cholesterol, ↑ appetite.'. Carried VERBATIM as the note's two table blocks and conveyed as ONE original KYP selectivity-fork map (the α1 = Gq mechanism strip, the three fork cards, the uses/toxicity strips, the epinephrine-reversal band, the α2-mirror band, the boundary strip, the reading-rule footer) — no artwork reproduced.

notes: Census (pdfimages + text layer): the α-blockers block's printed visual set is ONE element — the THREE-COLUMN DRUG/APPLICATIONS/ADVERSE EFFECTS TABLE of four rows grouped by selectivity, PURE TEXT (ZERO rasters on pdf 265 — pdfimages returns no rows; COPYRIGHTED, never reproduced as artwork). Pheochromocytoma (used preoperatively)...' and phentolamine 'Reversible.' with the MAOI-tyramine/cocaine-2nd-line/extravasation uses), α1-SELECTIVE (the -osin four with 'Urinary symptoms of BPH; PTSD (prazosin); hypertension (except tamsulosin).' and '1st-dose orthostatic hypotension, dizziness, headache.'), α2-SELECTIVE (mirtazapine 'Depression.' with 'Sedation, ↑ serum cholesterol, ↑ appetite.'); THE USES STRIP — the pheo/HTN/BPH/emergency lane sort; THE TOXICITY STRIP — 'Orthostatic hypotension, reflex tachycardia.' vs the first-dose rule vs the mirtazapine metabolic set; THE EPINEPHRINE-REVERSAL BAND — book 242's printed 'After α-blockade' graphs bridged to the nonselective rows (KYP bridge, flagged); THE α2-MIRROR BAND — the mirtazapine/clonidine same-page mirror against book 238's autoreceptor sentence; THE BOUNDARY STRIP — the PH22/PH23 same-page split pinned from below; the reading-rule footer).
